ResearchProjectDef.label: solar deepdrill
ResearchProjectDef.description: Machine a deepdrill bit from sunsteel. It drills much faster than a standard deepdrill and brings up more ore from every bore.

ResearchProjectDef.label: kwazaari deepdrill
ResearchProjectDef.description: Quasar-grade bits and a reinforced borefield make for the fastest and most productive deepdrill. The upgraded borefield architecture also suppresses infestation formation around drill operations.
